description: You are a child development psychologist at the Cedar Grove Child Development Center constructing a standardized multi-domain developmental assessment battery using GCompris. GCompris educational software is open on the screen. Your task is to: (1) Navigate to and complete at least one activity from each of FOUR distinct cognitive domains — Mathematical Reasoning (Math/Numbers category), Language and Literacy (Language/ABC category), Scientific Inquiry (Science/Experiment sub-tab), and Spatial/Logical Thinking (Games category, e.g., Maze or Memory). (2) For each activity you complete, document: the exact activity name, the cognitive domain it belongs to, what developmental skill it tests, and how you performed. (3) Write a Multi-Domain Developmental Assessment Battery report to ~/Desktop/developmental_assessment_battery.txt. The report must have a separate section for each of the four domains, listing the activity you completed in that domain and your assessment findings. This battery will be used by staff at the center to evaluate children ages 4-8 for developmental readiness. Login: ga / password123
